title: RIKEN AICS Annual Report FY2015, Chapter 1: System Software Research Team
authors: RIKEN Advanced Institute for Computational Science, System Software Research Team

passages.note: The software team compared FX100 Tofu2-assisted RDMA atomic locking with an FX10 generic Open MPI implementation for 1,000 shared-lock calls. It also describes distinct MPICH work on K. The synchronization algorithms and stacks are different.
